:::{#cor-gamma-exponential}
#### The gamma distribution with shape 1 is the exponential

If $T \sim \dGamf{1, \rate}$,
then $T$ has the [exponential distribution](random-variables.qmd#def-exponential) with [rate](#def-event-rate) $\rate$.

:::

::: proof

For $t > 0$:

$$
\ba
f(t)
&= \frac{\rate^{1}}{\gammafn(1)} \, t^{1 - 1} \ef{-\rate t}
&& (\text{gamma density with } \shape = 1) \\
&= \rate \, t^{0} \ef{-\rate t}
&& (\gammafn(1) = 1 \text{ and } 1 - 1 = 0) \\
&= \rate \ef{-\rate t}
&& (t^0 = 1)
\ea
$$

and $f(t) = 0$ for $t \le 0$.
This is the [exponential density](random-variables.qmd#def-exponential) with rate $\rate$.

:::
